acceptance_scope: Bounded P150x2 traced structured reads in both 128- and 256-token batch buckets while two long generation prefixes remain cached; not general model accuracy, throughput, or production deployment acceptance

trial.method: ttwkv7-owner-control isolate, direct unprivileged packaged candidate on localhost:8000, bounded probe, EXIT trap candidate stop and original-owner restore

trial_history.first_invalid_attempt: qwen38-read-batch-lanes-first-attempt.json: omitted traced/grouped prefill flags, timed out on A, then original-owner ethernet-core failure required board reset
trial_history.second_invalid_attempt: Missing production prefill flags; B continuation had no prefix hit before any batched read. Preserved as /tmp/qwen-lanes/read-lanes-physical-invalid-eager.json and matching log.
trial_history.first_correctly_flagged_attempt: Four concurrent short reads exercised three physical 128-bucket batch routes, but the fixture returned 82 rather than the hard-coded 84 tokens and its assertion stopped before A. Preserved as /tmp/qwen-lanes/read-lanes-physical-valid-preflight-82.json and matching log.
trial_history.second_correctly_flagged_attempt: A/B prefixes survived three 198-token medium single-read traces; there was no 256-bucket batch route and no 256 acceptance claim. Preserved as /tmp/qwen-lanes/read-lanes-physical-128-protected-256-unbatched.json and matching log.
trial_history.accepted_trial_fixture_change: Four concurrent 198-token reads leave three eligible after an early single dispatch; three 256-bucket batch routes were observed. Raw accepted probe: /tmp/qwen-lanes/read-lanes-physical-accepted-128-256.json; server log: /tmp/qwen-lanes/physical-server-accepted-128-256.log.

verification_reported_before_hardware: Offline nix build of .#qwen38, .#checks.x86_64-linux.qwen36 and .#checks.x86_64-linux.qwen38-nixos-service passed; candidate package pinned by .pi/qwen38-read-batch-lanes-candidate
interpretation: A correctly configured direct candidate physically replayed both captured batched-read buckets while A and B generation prefixes occupied 130048 and 16384 tokens. Four short and four medium concurrent reads each yielded three batched and one single route. B and A hit their entire prefixes afterward and generated identical token IDs. The historical B cold request hash differs, so this receipt makes no paired performance or broad model-quality claim. The undeployed candidate does not alter the root-owned production service.
